name: Campingplatz Kaseler
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Kaseler is situated in the mountain basin of Ginzling, a charming mountaineering village in the Zillertal valley. The park features pitches for motorhomes and tents right beside the alpine river. Guests enjoy direct access to celebrated hiking trails and mountain bike routes leading deep into the upper Zillertal Alps. The sanitary blocks are functionally equipped, and a local inn and village shop are nearby.
